title: Shadeclinger Armour
summary: Light armour grants +1 Stealth and Advantage on saves while obscured.

fields.Defence: AC 12 + Dexterity. Light Armour proficiency. +1 Stealth.
fields.Shadeclinger: While lightly or heavily obscured, gain Advantage on saving throws.
fields.Acquisition: Buy from Quartermaster Talli at Last Light Inn.
fields.Base value: 130 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
